mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, total_amount, product_amount, shipping_fee, discount_amount, paid_amount, payment_method, paid_at, status, remark, logistics_company, tracking_number, shipped_at, completed_at, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{totalAmount}, #{productAmount}, #{shippingFee}, #{discountAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paidAt}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{logisticsCompany}, #{trackingNumber}, #{shippedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{cancelledAt}, #{cancelReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE orders SET paid_at = #{paidAt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE orders SET completed_at = #{completedAt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) as pending_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 END) as paid_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 END) as shipped_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 END) as completed_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 END) as cancelled_orders, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) as paid_amount FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) as count FROM orders WHERE payment_method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_method

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) as paid_amount, COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) as average_amount, COALESCE(MIN(total_amount), 0) as min_amount, COALESCE(MAX(total_amount), 0) as max_amount FROM orders

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as total_amount FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE(paid_at) as date, COUNT(*) as payment_count, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) as payment_amount FROM orders WHERE paid_at IS NOT NULL AND paid_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(paid_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE(completed_at) as date, COUNT(*) as completion_count FROM orders WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(completed_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE(cancelled_at) as date, COUNT(*) as cancellation_count FROM orders WHERE cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(cancelled_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as unique_users, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as total_revenue, COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) as average_order_value, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0) as completion_rate FROM orders
SELECT HOUR(created_at) as hour, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY HOUR(created_at) ORDER BY hour

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(receiver_address, ',', 1) as region, COUNT(*) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as total_amount FROM orders WHERE receiver_address IS NOT NULL AND receiver_address != '' GROUP BY region ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.name as category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE o.created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, p.image as product_image, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal), 0) as total_amount FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND o.status IN (2, 3, 4) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.image ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as total_users, COUNT(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 END) as repeat_users, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 2) as repeat_rate FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY user_id ) as user_orders

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, completed_at)) as avg_processing_hours, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, shipped_at)) as avg_shipping_hours, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, paid_at, shipped_at)) as avg_fulfillment_hours FROM orders WHERE status = 4 AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND paid_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 END) as cancelled_orders, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as cancellation_rate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as cancelled_amount FROM orders

update.foreach: UPDATE orders SET status = #{statuses[index]}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId}
UPDATE orders SET paid_at = #{paidAts[index]}, status = #{statuses[index]}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId}

UPDATE orders SET logistics_company = #{logisticsCompanies[index]}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumbers[index]}, shipped_at = #{shippedAts[index]}, status = #{statuses[index]}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId}
